subject.title: fix(codex): backoff startup connection-close retries and surface exhaustion (#83959) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bounded multi-second startup recovery window for classified Codex app-server connection closes in exchange for avoiding premature scheduled-turn failures?
rationale: The code path is still missing on current main and the implementation is narrowly scoped, but the retry budget deliberately changes the user-visible failure latency and must be evaluated on a rebased integration result.

options.title: Adopt bounded recovery after rebase
options.body: Rebase the PR, retain abortable retries only for classified startup connection closes, and approve after the current-head focused and subprocess proof pass.

options.title: Keep fast failure
options.body: Decline the added retry window if immediate failure is preferred for this runtime, leaving the canonical startup-close issue open for a different recovery design.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded recovery after rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, retain abortable retries only for classified startup connection closes, and approve after the current-head focused and subprocess proof pass.
